map.正畸力与牙移动评估器 使用指南: Orthodontic Force and Tooth Movement Evaluator User Guide
map.根据施加力值与牙移动类型，判断正畸力是否处于最佳生物学力范围，避免牙根吸收与组织: Judges from the applied force and the tooth movement type whether the orthodontic force sits in the optimal biological range, avoiding root resorption and tissue necrosis.
map.正畸力 = 牙移动需求: Orthodontic force = the force required for tooth movement
map.关闭间隙选择轻力，输入力值后工具判断是否在最佳范围并提示加力间隔。: Turn off the gaps to use light force, and after entering the force the tool judges whether it is in the optimal range and suggests the interval between force increases.
map.整体移动 vs 控根移动，比较所需力值差异（控根力更小）。: Whole-body movement vs root control movement, comparing the force values required (root control needs less force).
map.力值过大预警，提示牙根吸收与坏死风险。（结果仅供口腔健康科普与自我初筛参考，不替: An over-large force triggers a warning about root resorption and necrosis risk. map.：输入：前牙整体内收力 = 60g/牙\n判定：处于轻力生理范围（通常数十克级）:
Input: whole anterior teeth retraction force = 60 g per tooth
Judgment: within the light-force physiological range (typically tens of grams) so movement can be slow; above 150 g easily causes hyalinization and root resorption.

map.最佳正畸力多大？: What is the optimal orthodontic force?
map.因移动类型而异：整体移动约 50~100g/牙，控根更小，扩弓与颌间牵引各有范围: It varies by movement type: whole-body movement needs about 50-100 g per tooth, root control is smaller, and arch expansion and intermaxillary traction each have their range; light sustained force is best.
map.力太大有什么危害？: What harm does too much force do?
map.过大压力致牙周膜透明样变、牙根吸收甚至坏死，移动反而变慢；应遵正畸医师加力方案。: Excessive force causes hyalinization of the periodontal ligament, root resorption and even necrosis, and movement actually slows; follow the orthodontist's force progression plan.
map.能自己调力吗？: Can I adjust the force myself?
map.不能。正畸力值由医师根据托槽/弓丝系统设计，擅自调力会损及牙根与牙周；异常疼痛及: No. Orthodontic force values are designed by the physician for the bracket/archwire system, and adjusting force on your own can damage the root and periodontium; return promptly if the pain is unusual.
